title: Even If and Inversion: Hubiera Without Si
goal: Drop si and begin with hubiera, and say "even if" about the past with aun cuando or aunque and hubiera.

items: I can drop si and begin a past counterfactual with hubiera and a past participle.
I can say "even if" about the past with aun cuando or aunque and hubiera.
I can use the new words for dilemmas and conclusions.
